title: A debt from 2019 - court date Monday
scenario: A caller says they represent a collections agency chasing an unpaid $1,240 debt from 2019. They say a court filing goes through Monday unless you settle today by card over the phone.

answers.A: Pay a smaller amount today to make the court filing stop.
answers.B: Ask for the collector's name, company, and a written notice, then verify independently before paying anything.
answers.C: Give your card number now to avoid the court filing.

explanation: Legitimate debt collectors are required to send written validation of a debt on request, and real court processes don't resolve with a same-day card payment over the phone.
proTip: A real debt survives a request for it in writing. A fake one doesn't.
